title: State Prices for Gas: An Average Above $4, but Some States Offer Relief
description:
State prices for gas hit your weekly budget: Forbes reported an average above $4 a gallon on October 6, 2026. Newsweek’s October 5 coverage reported falling prices as some states suspended fuel taxes, making local prices worth checking rather than relying on the national average.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#StatePricesForGas #GasPrices #FuelTaxes #gaspricesbystate #averagegaspricetoday
